title.narrative: Partnerships for Syunik - Enhanced Community-Based Social Services

description.narrative:
The intervention logic reflects the interconnectedness of the action¿s overall objective, specific objective, and

outputs. The action's overall objective will be achieved through one specific objective and three outputs.

Overall Objective: Civil Society Organizations are resilient, trusted and accountable actors that contribute to

reducing poverty, inequality and vulnerability in Armenia

Specific Objective: Civil Society Organizations effectively cooperate with government authorities to deliver

financially sustainable community-based social services that serve the needs of vulnerable populations in

Syunik province
